title: Expired middle waiter cannot strand its successor

contract.intent: Expired middle waiter cannot strand its successor
preconditions: Fresh test-owned State; only frozen production celld_logic::on_event mutates it.
Empty State; residency1, activations1; a/1 holds permit; b/2 and c/3 queue.
All completion operation IDs and timers come from the exact emitted effects; late IDs are previously issued IDs, never fabricated authority.
All input storage/lease/proof replies are synthetic facts. No executor, network, runtime, or fleet service is simulated as empirical evidence.
Static source/pin check and independent review required; compiler, test and runtime have not been launched.
trace: Capture b queue timer; queue c
Fire b timeout150; assert CapacityExhausted and queue only c
Complete a owner read absent; assert no a CAS
Capture c read emitted by abandoned a resolution
contract.oracle: Timeout and cancellation remove only their demand and allow next cell admission
contract.cleanup: Finish every locally completed request and cancel each remaining ownership-only waiter as shown. H::done checks no pending requests, active cells, activation/capacity queues, activation/eviction/release/adoption permits, or nonterminal phases. Drop isolated in-memory State; no external resources created. Stored timer descriptors are never launched.
